description: This file defines an abstract class 'Links' for handling collections of links within Drupal's Views module, including methods for constructing link options, generating link data, and integrating with Drupal routing and URL systems.

classes.name: Links
classes.description: An abstract handler class for providing a collection of links in Drupal Views.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the Links class, initializing with configuration, plugin ID, definition, and redirect destination service.

methods.name: usesGroupBy
methods.description: Indicates whether the query uses GROUP BY clause; returns FALSE.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the links field, including 'fields' and 'destination'.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the options form for configuring which fields to include as links and whether to include a destination parameter.

methods.name: getLinks
methods.description: Generates and returns an array of link data based on configured fields, including URL, title, and optional query parameters.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Empty method, likely overridden in subclasses to modify the query.
